description.value: Back and Forth Bar is a games-and-drinks venue in Vancouver offering six rentable ping-pong tables, two basketball pop-a-shot machines, air hockey, and buck hunter alongside a rotating selection of BC craft beers and cocktails. The space bills itself as a one-of-a-kind atmosphere in Vancouver and welcomes outside food, making it a flexible social stop. Entry is restricted to ages 19 and up with valid ID.

The outside-food policy, drinks-only menu, and 19+ entry requirement are all confirmed from the website's about, menu, and contact sections.
